calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(business_date) as min_date,
  MAX(business_date) as max_date,
  COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

SELECT 
  SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', business_date) as month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days,
  COUNT(*) as row_count,
  SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', business_date)

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count,
  MIN(store_id) as min_store_id,
  MAX(store_id) as max_store_id
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT DISTINCT
  store_id,
  store_name,
  format
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = true
  AND store_id >= 895
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
  AND (store_id = 900 OR store_id = 999)
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id

SELECT 
  MIN(net_sales) as min_daily_sales,
  MAX(net_sales) as max_daily_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_sales < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_days,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_sales = 0 THEN 1 END) as zero_days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  SUM(net_amount) as total_from_fact_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  SUM(net_amount) as sales_net,
  (SELECT SUM(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date >= '2026-09-01' AND return_date < '2026-10-01') as returns_net,
  SUM(net_amount) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date >= '2026-09-01' AND return_date < '2026-10-01'), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date < '2026-10-01'

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days,
  SUM(receipts) as total_receipts,
  SUM(units_sold) as total_units,
  SUM(net_sales_before_returns) as sales_before_returns,
  SUM(returns_net) as returns,
  SUM(net_sales) as net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date < '2026-10-01'
